title.summary_zh: 清单辅助审阅的合成研究（演示）
title.summary_en: A Synthetic Study of Checklist-Assisted Review

evidence.quote: A Synthetic Study of Checklist-Assisted Review

background.summary_zh: 审阅者检查短报告，识别报告遗漏。
background.summary_en: Reviewers inspect short reports to identify reporting omissions.

evidence.quote: Reviewers inspect short reports to identify reporting omissions.

problem.summary_zh: 本演示考察清单能否改善遗漏识别。
problem.summary_en: This demonstration examines whether a checklist improves omission detection.

evidence.quote: This demonstration examines whether a checklist improves omission detection.

purpose.summary_zh: 比较清单辅助审阅和无辅助审阅。
purpose.summary_en: The aim was to compare checklist-assisted review with unaided review.

evidence.quote: The aim was to compare checklist-assisted review with unaided review.

research_questions.summary_zh: RQ1：使用清单是否增加识别出的遗漏数量？
research_questions.summary_en: RQ1: Does checklist access increase the number of omissions detected?

evidence.quote: RQ1: Does checklist access increase the number of omissions detected?

methodology.summary_zh: 随机分为两个各六人的组间条件。
methodology.summary_en: Participants were randomly assigned to two groups of six in a between-subjects design.

evidence.quote: Participants were randomly assigned to two groups of six in a between-subjects design.

participants_or_dataset.summary_zh: 通过校园邮件招募十二名研究生志愿者。
participants_or_dataset.summary_en: Twelve volunteer graduate students were recruited through a campus email.

evidence.quote: Twelve volunteer graduate students were recruited through a campus email.

data.summary_zh: 采集了任务中的遗漏日志和任务后的信心评分。
data.summary_en: The study collected omission logs during the task and confidence ratings afterwards.

evidence.quote: The interface recorded each submitted omission and its timestamp during the task.
After the task, participants rated confidence on a scale from 1 to 5.

findings.summary_zh: 清单组在此任务中发现更多遗漏。
findings.summary_en: The checklist group detected more omissions than the control group in this task.

evidence.quote: The checklist group detected more omissions than the control group in this task.

contributions.summary_zh: 展示评估审阅清单的可追溯流程。
contributions.summary_en: This demonstration illustrates a traceable workflow for evaluating a review checklist.

evidence.quote: This demonstration illustrates a traceable workflow for evaluating a review checklist.

evidence.quote: The small sample and single report limit generalization.
